title: Reference Architectures & Patterns — Request & Control Flow
purpose: Traces the End-to-End Cache-Aside Request Flow: demonstrates request dispatch, cache lookup, Spanner query on miss, and asynchronous cache repopulation.
routing_rationale: A clean cache-aside implementation guarantees fresh data while protecting backend relational databases from read query exhaustion.

nodes.label: Catalog Microservice
nodes.detail: Receives request; executes cache-aside lookup logic.

nodes.label: Memorystore Redis
nodes.detail: Stores JSON serialized catalog items with 1-hour TTL.

nodes.label: Cloud Spanner Leader
nodes.detail: Executes SELECT * FROM Products WHERE Sku = 'sku-99214'.

nodes.label: Cloud Pub/Sub Invalidation
nodes.detail: Publishes cache invalidation event when catalog updates occur.

steps.title: Cache Evaluation
steps.action: App service queries Redis for SKU. If key exists, returns payload immediately in 1.2ms.
steps.why_traversal: Eliminates roundtrips to relational database for repeated read queries.

steps.title: Persistence Query & Cache Repopulation
steps.action: On cache miss, queries Spanner, returns response to user, and asynchronously populates Redis.
steps.why_traversal: Ensures subsequent requests for this SKU hit memory cache.

steps.title: Cache Coherence Invalidation
steps.action: When inventory or price changes, Spanner commit triggers Pub/Sub to invalidate Redis key.
steps.why_traversal: Prevents stale inventory or incorrect pricing data from persisting in cache.

scenarios.label: Deadlock Invalidation Worker
scenarios.root_cause: Invalidation subscriber crashed due to unhandled JSON schema change.
scenarios.diverted_path: Redis cache serves out-of-date product pricing for 60 minutes.
scenarios.blast_radius: Customers buy items at incorrect prices.
scenarios.recovery: Deploy schema validation on Pub/Sub messages and add dead-letter topic alerting.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.

scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.
